findings.finding: The plan treated crops as a completeness requirement even though L000 teaches a social ritual between two participants. Cropping the exchanges weakens the relational evidence, while existing portraits already provide isolated identity views.

required_repairs: Use full two-participant scenes for greeting, dialogue, practice, and picture-book pages.
Use accepted portraits, not scene crops, when a comprehension control requires isolated identity choices.
Leave literal_crops empty because no L000 component has an unresolved pointing or salience problem.
Make crop optional in the pipeline and require every future crop to name the problem it solves.
operator_note: Cropping for cropping's sake is unproductive; in a two-character greeting, seeing both characters is the point.
